steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Y'know, honestly... it wouldn't even surprise me if this place got robbed.
Wynn seems to catch her own poor word choice and quickly backpedals.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Oh! No, no, I mean, a lot of the items here aren't being maintained properly.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: It's just... how do I put it... total "paperwork-only" vibes!

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: We checked earlier and their exhibit management is kind of... sloppy.
She clears her throat and earnestly produces several images.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: See these display labels? Some are hanging off, and nobody's fixed them.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: And their patrol logs... Theoretically, different staff check each hall every hour...

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: But some shifts just say "1AM check," "2AM check," "3AM check"—

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Same handwriting every time. One person clearly filled the whole thing out!
She spreads her hands, arriving at her own conclusion.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: I mean, sure, not just anyone can waltz into a gallery... But with security this lazy? Any decent thief would be tempted.

And so, you call the Public Security Bureau without another word. Upon connection, you request strict supervision of the Eastside Museum of Humanities' security protocols and daily exhibit management.
